scope: Native SessionStore backward compatibility for an omitted optional pendingCleanup field; isolated actual-file regression. Root-owned UI integration verification is pending and not claimed here.
reportedSymptom: An older conversation file was rejected with Conversation cleanup records are invalid. Original data was preserved.; the UI showed no current chat and Send was unavailable.

rootCause.explanation: doc.object() returns a temporary non-const QJsonObject. Its mutable operator[] inserts a null value for a missing key and returns QJsonValueRef; auto retains that proxy after the temporary is destroyed. The optional-field check therefore does not reliably receive an owned Undefined value. The synthetic legacy files reproduce the exact rejection. value() is non-mutating and returns an owned QJsonValue, preserving Undefined for an omitted field.
rootCause.qtContract: Installed Qt6.11.2 qjsonobject.h operator[] mutable overload returns QJsonValueRef; qjsonvalue.h Qt6 proxy stores a QJsonObject pointer. No Qt source or upstream reference was changed.

userMetadataCorroboration.observation: One older schema-1 chat without the optional field.
userMetadataCorroboration.privacy: Metadata-only corroboration; no real profile path, file hash, chat content or credential is retained here. This subagent did not read user profile/history data.

change: One lookup changed to value(), with an explanatory lifetime/legacy comment. Validation rules, storage format and cleanup authority remain unchanged.
newCoverage: Two real-file legacy cases: empty sessions and one existing chat omit pendingCleanup; load succeeds, no cleanup callback runs, and file bytes remain unchanged until an explicit save.
The existing legacy chat retains its exact message JSON, metadata and unsent draft through append/save/restart; the normal save emits an empty pendingCleanup array.
Explicit null, boolean, number, string, object and more than 10,000 cleanup entries remain invalid; load/save/cleanup refuse them and original file bytes remain unchanged.
existingCoverage: All existing cleanup regressions also pass: invalid/duplicate/case-alias IDs, retained-chat conflicts, non-string entries, stale revisions, inter-window lock protection, partial/exception retry behavior and root-junction containment.
testMethod: Independent private Release QtCore/QtTest build compiles actual SessionStore, ScopedDirectory, QueuedMessages and AgentPresentation with the production cleanup test. Before target uses a byte copy of the prior SessionStore.cpp; after target uses the fixed production source. Hidden native processes, synthetic temporary directories only; no shared build or live service requests.
canonicalization: SHA256 of source and evidence bytes after CRLF-to-LF replacement only; retained text/XML uses LF.
limits: Detailed UI startup/Send/restart regression and rebuilt application verification remain root-owned and pending at audit creation.
The fix accepts an absent optional field; it does not reinterpret explicit null/invalid fields, repair malformed records, overwrite rejected data or delete history.
33 passing cases include QtTest init/cleanup. They establish these exercised storage cases, not a universal zero-defect or full-port parity guarantee.
execution: Existing before/after evidence copied without repeating tests; no README/CMake changes or commit.
uiVerification: Completed separately in audit/composer-send-verification.json; initial pending wording describes audit preparation time.
